summary: Frontend testing of sign-up school selector, T&C checkbox, Terms/Privacy pages, FeedbackModal fix, and Google OAuth code fix. Found and fixed a critical bug where /terms and /privacy routes showed IntroScreen instead of actual content.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: /terms and /privacy routes showed IntroScreen (intro animation) instead of the actual page content when visited directly for the first time (sessionStorage empty). Fix applied: skip intro when path is /terms or /privacy.
ui_bugs.priority: HIGH - was blocking T&C and Privacy page access

critical_code_review_comments: The showIntro check in App() didn't account for /terms and /privacy routes — these are public pages that should never be blocked by the intro animation. Fixed by adding path check in useState initializer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 features tested and passing: (1) School selector shows Brooklyn National Public School + National Public School. (2) T&C checkbox gates Create Account button. (3) T&C/Privacy links open in _blank. (4) /terms page loads with full content. (5) /privacy page loads with full content. (6) FeedbackModal opens without MessageSquarePlus error. The critical fix was adding path check in App.js showIntro state initializer to skip intro for /terms and /privacy routes.
rca_of_bug: Root cause: App.js App() function initializes showIntro=true for all first-time visitors regardless of route. When user navigates directly to /terms or /privacy (new tab), sessionStorage is empty so showIntro=true, rendering IntroScreen INSTEAD of AppRouter. Routes /terms and /privacy are never matched. Fix: Added `if (path === '/terms' || path === '/privacy') return false;` in the useState initializer.
